summary: Iteration 3 backend-only. Validated JWT httpOnly cookie migration + backward compat with Bearer, /auth/logout clearing cookie, /api/files no longer accepting ?token= query (now Depends(current_user) via cookie or Bearer with APP_NAME + company_id path scoping), and full regression on prior features. 17/17 new checks passed + 26/26 iter-2 regression = 43/43. Zero regressions.
passed: POST /api/auth/login sets Set-Cookie automa_token with HttpOnly, Secure, Max-Age=604800, Path=/ and returns {token,user} body (backward compat)
GET /api/auth/me: 401 with no auth; 200 with cookie only; 200 with Bearer only; 401 with bad cookie; 401 with bad Bearer
POST /api/auth/logout returns 200, emits Set-Cookie clearing automa_token (Max-Age=0 / past expires), and subsequent /auth/me on same session is 401
GET /api/files with ?token=<jwt> in query -> 401 (query auth no longer works)
GET /api/files with no auth -> 401; with auth but path outside APP_NAME (automa-erp) -> 403; with auth but wrong company_id in path -> 403; enforced identically via cookie and via Bearer
Regression smoke via BOTH cookie (requests.Session) and Bearer header on same user: /companies create, /clients POST+GET, /categories+/products POST+GET, /orders POST + cross-auth GET all 200
Previous iter-2 suite (coupons + cron + regression) still 26/26

minor.issue: Backend code sets SameSite=Lax (as specified) but the preview ingress rewrites it to SameSite=None; Partitioned to support the emergentagent.com iframe/cross-site preview. Functionally correct in preview; verify prod deployment preserves Lax.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1206 lines - well beyond 700-line guideline; split into routers (auth, payments, coupons, cron, files, erp resources).

response.delete_cookie in /auth/logout should also pass secure=True and samesite matching the set path (some browsers require identical attrs to clear). Currently only path='/' is passed - works because most browsers match by (name, domain, path), but stricter setups may leave the cookie. Recommend using same (httponly, secure, samesite) triplet on delete.

/files scoping check: `if user.get('company_id') and f'/{user["company_id"]}/' not in path` — if a user has NO company_id yet (fresh signup), they can read any path inside APP_NAME/. Consider requiring company membership OR explicit ownership check (e.g., path startswith APP_NAME/uploads/<company_id>/).
Cookie set with secure=True is fine over HTTPS, but locally over HTTP (dev) the cookie will be dropped silently. Consider gating secure on env (e.g., APP_ENV=='prod') for local dev.

current_user reads token from cookie first, then Bearer; if BOTH are present with different users (e.g., stale cookie + new bearer), the cookie wins. May be surprising; consider preferring Bearer when explicit or documenting order.
